Turbo 

This model was designed for fishing in deep spots and for trolling. Aggressive vibration provokes aggressive fish in the deepest places of the fishery. While trolling it is advisable to jig the lure very slowly and to descent the tip very quickly just like in jigging. It is a very effective technique particularly in fisheries with high trolling pressure.
It is designed for: pike, zander, trout and catfish.

NOTE: TURBO FOR TROLLING

Use Turbo 35g while trolling. It is a bait that responds well to the movements of the rod. Pulled up and down in slow trolling, it moves like in jigging, and its effectiveness is well known.

The second group of lures in our offer are spinning tails with many supporters the number of whom is increasing from year to year.
The lure has been developed in the United States for bass fishing, and has gained immense popularity. It soon turned out that it is also effective in fishing for other predatory fish. Its popularity among anglers continues to grow, even in Europe. In Poland, this lure is commonly referred to as “spinning tail”; It is known in many spinning circles as “ secret weapon” ;. After many tests SPINMAD company introduces its own line of this versatile bait.

The characteristics that determine its versatility:
• compact design allowing for long casts,
• Constant spinning motion of the wing during all spinning techniques,
• the possibility of fishing all areas of water with one lure,
• While working it does not twist the line
• its vibration is well felt by the angler
• Tail spinning reduces the sinking speed
• Great for fishing under the surface, for jigging and descending techniques.

When the fish are active you will catch them on any lure, but when they are sleepy and they do not want to feed you need a stronger incentive to provoke them to attack – such as a spinning tail. Rotating paddle transfers vibrations to the body of the lure, which is an additional incentive for fish. Any angler who has targeted pike, asp, perch and trout should have SIPNMAD spinning tails in his arsenal.

There are 3 basic ways of running a spinning tail:
• Monotonous retrieving in water spots
• Jigging in the depths by raising and lowering a rod while winding in fishing line,
• Classic drop - that is, two or three moves of the handle and drop to the bottom.

Spinning tails action in the water.
A vibrating body and rotating paddle (tail) arouse interest in fish even when the lure is retrieve in a classic, the easiest way. But its qualities are revealed only during jigging in the deeper parts of the fisheries and technically difficult places.

Advantages of spinning tails:
• unprecedented casting range unattainable by other lures
• construction of the bait allows fishing in all parts of the water
• While working it doesn’t twist the line
• perfect while fishing in places covered with water plants
• Bait vibration is well felt by angler
